minutes.headline: ZBA found a larger maintenance garage at the Wham Road 40B complex an insubstantial change, so no further hearing is needed.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a request to modify a 40B comprehensive permit, enlarging an approved maintenance garage. Members said the change was not substantial, a motion was made and seconded, and the chair said nothing more was required. A board member then raised the removed playground, which the applicant said the town's Parks department declined to take over; no action was taken.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals determined that enlarging the maintenance garage at the 40B complex is not a substantial change to the comprehensive permit.
The chair stated the permit is deemed modified and the board has nothing more to do, so no further hearing is required.
A member raised the removed playground; the applicant said the town's Parks department declined to take over the recreation parcel, and no action was taken.
The applicant was told to resubmit for a building permit, with drainage requirements left to the building official rather than the board.

why_it_matters: A larger garage at an approved 40B development went through as an insubstantial change, so it skipped a full public hearing, and the vote count was not audible in the recording.
The playground and recreation parcel that the town's Parks department did not take over remain unresolved, so whether that space is ever built or maintained is still open.
